author: Bill Ferguson
name: group_persistence
description: Maintains image group membership across database rebuilds by storing grouping information as tags written to XMP sidecar files.
description-extensive: This tool makes sure the way you have grouped your photos survives even if darktable's catalog is lost and has to be rebuilt from the sidecar files stored next to your images. It quietly watches for grouping changes and records them, so your groups can be restored automatically when photos are re-imported. There is also a shortcut to record grouping for your existing collections. No extra software is required.
